scope: All SQLite tables except explicitly listed generated/derived state; all regular bytes under workspace/files and optional workspace/recordings (including raw PCM and recovery journals). SQLite/WAL layout, .staging, diagnostics and lock files are outside this canonical-content audit. No concurrent user mutations or asset writers are allowed during a snapshot.

advanced_button_actions.schema: CREATE TABLE advanced_button_actions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id),label TEXT NOT NULL,commands_json TEXT NOT NULL)

advanced_page_locks.schema: CREATE TABLE advanced_page_locks(page_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES pages(id),locked INTEGER NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL)

advanced_templates.schema: CREATE TABLE advanced_templates(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id),name TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

approvals.schema:
CREATE TABLE approvals (
 approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope_grant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 policy_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(policy_revision)='integer' AND policy_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9223372036854775807), command_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(command_hash)=64),
 expected_revisions_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(expected_revisions_json)),
 expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, approved_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','approved','consumed','revoked','expired'))
)

attachments.schema:
CREATE TABLE attachments (
 page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id), block_id TEXT, file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id),
 PRIMARY KEY(page_id,file_id), FOREIGN KEY(page_id,block_id) REFERENCES blocks(page_id,id)
)

autofill_batches.schema: CREATE TABLE autofill_batches(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version=1),actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,collection_id TEXT NOT NULL,body_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body_json)),created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

automation_rules.schema: CREATE TABLE automation_rules(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id),version INTEGER NOT NULL,rule_json TEXT NOT NULL,event_cursor INTEGER NOT NULL,next_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

automation_runs.schema: CREATE TABLE automation_runs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,rule_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES automation_rules(id),rule_version INTEGER NOT NULL,occurrence_key TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,diagnostic TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',created_at TEXT NOT NULL,commands_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',UNIQUE(rule_id,rule_version,occurrence_key))

backup_destinations.schema: CREATE TABLE backup_destinations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,grant_id TEXT NOT NULL,path TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,job_id TEXT REFERENCES jobs(job_id))

backups.schema: CREATE TABLE backups(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('active','complete','failed','interrupted')),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

blocks.schema:
CREATE TABLE blocks (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id), parent_block_id TEXT,
 sort_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sort_key)=12 AND sort_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'),
 type TEXT NOT NULL, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(schema_version>=1), data_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(data_json)),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(revision NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(revision,1,1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND (length(revision)<19 OR (length(revision)=19 AND revision<='9223372036854775807'))),
 UNIQUE(page_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(page_id,parent_block_id) REFERENCES blocks(page_id,id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 CHECK(parent_block_id IS NULL OR parent_block_id<>id)
)

cancellation_receipts.schema: CREATE TABLE cancellation_receipts(actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,cancellation_id TEXT NOT NULL,transaction_id TEXT REFERENCES mutation_history(transaction_id),PRIMARY KEY(actor_id,cancellation_id))

collections.schema:
CREATE TABLE collections (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id), owning_page_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 title TEXT NOT NULL, title_property_id TEXT NOT NULL, title_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'title' CHECK(title_type='title'),
 system_role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK(system_role IN ('none','tasks')),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(revision NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(revision,1,1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND (length(revision)<19 OR (length(revision)=19 AND revision<='9223372036854775807'))),
 UNIQUE(workspace_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id,owning_page_id) REFERENCES pages(workspace_id,id),
 FOREIGN KEY(id,title_property_id,title_type) REFERENCES properties(collection_id,id,type) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

files.schema:
CREATE TABLE files (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id), content_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(content_hash)=64 AND content_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),

 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(revision NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(revision,1,1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND (length(revision)<19 OR (length(revision)=19 AND revision<='9223372036854775807'))),

)

)

import_runs.schema: CREATE TABLE import_runs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL,plan_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(plan_json)),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

job_authorizations.schema: CREATE TABLE job_authorizations(job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES jobs(job_id),actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,grant_id TEXT NOT NULL,policy_revision TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('approved','revoked')))

job_events.schema: CREATE TABLE job_events(cursor INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(job_id),payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)))

CREATE TABLE job_results (
 job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(job_id), unit_key TEXT NOT NULL,

)

job_sources.schema: CREATE TABLE job_sources(job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(job_id),entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,revision TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(job_id,entity_type,entity_id))

job_units.schema: CREATE TABLE job_units(job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(job_id),unit_key TEXT NOT NULL,identities_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(identities_json)),PRIMARY KEY(job_id,unit_key))

jobs.schema:
CREATE TABLE jobs (
 job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 payload_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(payload_version=1), payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','running','retry_wait','cancel_requested','cancelled','succeeded','failed','interrupted')),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9223372036854775807), idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempt BETWEEN 0 AND 5),
 max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
 lease_token TEXT, lease_expires_at TEXT, next_attempt_at TEXT, checkpoint_ref TEXT,
 progress_json TEXT CHECK(progress_json IS NULL OR json_valid(progress_json)),
 error_json TEXT CHECK(error_json IS NULL OR json_valid(error_json)), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(workspace_id,kind,idempotency_key),
 CHECK(attempt<=max_attempts),
 CHECK((state IN ('running','cancel_requested') AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL)
    OR (state NOT IN ('running','cancel_requested') AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL))
)

kernel_meta.schema: CREATE TABLE kernel_meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

managed_provider_runs.schema: CREATE TABLE managed_provider_runs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body_json TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

meeting_archived_proposals_v1.schema: CREATE TABLE meeting_archived_proposals_v1(draft_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES meeting_intelligence(id),archived_at TEXT NOT NULL)

meeting_extraction_items.schema:
CREATE TABLE meeting_extraction_items(
   version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version=1), proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL,item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
   meeting_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings(id),evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN('page','task')),
   title TEXT NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,page_id TEXT NOT NULL,record_id TEXT NOT NULL,block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
   applied_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
   PRIMARY KEY(proposal_id,item_id),UNIQUE(page_id),UNIQUE(block_id))

meeting_intelligence.schema: CREATE TABLE meeting_intelligence(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,meeting_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings(id),page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id),evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('draft','applied')),body_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body_json)),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,job_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES jobs(job_id))

meeting_retention_v1.schema: CREATE TABLE meeting_retention_v1(meeting_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES meetings(id),exclude_search INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(exclude_search IN(0,1)))

meetings.schema:
CREATE TABLE meetings (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, page_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES pages(id), recording_file_id TEXT REFERENCES files(id), started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(duration_ms>=0), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('recording','captured','transcribing','ready','failed','cancelled')),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(revision NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(revision,1,1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND (length(revision)<19 OR (length(revision)=19 AND revision<='9223372036854775807')))
)

memory_entries.schema:
CREATE TABLE memory_entries (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, page_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES pages(id), scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('workspace','project','pages')),
 scope_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(scope_json)), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('preference','project_context','decision')),
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('proposed','active','disabled','stale','superseded','forgotten')), content TEXT, page_ref TEXT REFERENCES pages(id),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(revision NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(revision,1,1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND (length(revision)<19 OR (length(revision)=19 AND revision<='9223372036854775807'))),
 approved_at TEXT, approved_by_actor_id TEXT, supersedes_id TEXT REFERENCES memory_entries(id),
 CHECK(status<>'active' OR (approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by_actor_id IS NOT NULL)),
 CHECK((content IS NULL) <> (page_ref IS NULL)),
 CHECK((kind='project_context' AND page_ref IS NOT NULL) OR (kind<>'project_context' AND content IS NOT NULL)),
 CHECK(supersedes_id IS NULL OR supersedes_id<>id)
)

memory_sources.schema:
CREATE TABLE memory_sources (
 memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memory_entries(id), page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id),
 source_revision TEXT NOT NULL, block_id TEXT, meeting_id TEXT REFERENCES meetings(id), segment_id TEXT,
 start_ms INTEGER, end_ms INTEGER, source_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(source_index>=0),
 PRIMARY KEY(memory_id,source_index),
 CHECK((meeting_id IS NULL AND segment_id IS NULL AND start_ms IS NULL AND end_ms IS NULL) OR
 (meeting_id IS NOT NULL AND segment_id IS NOT NULL AND block_id IS NOT NULL AND start_ms>=0 AND end_ms>=start_ms))
)

mutation_history.schema:
CREATE TABLE mutation_history (
 history_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 request_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, origin TEXT NOT NULL
 CHECK(origin IN ('user','ai','external','import','restore','automation','system','migration')),
 scope_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(scope_json)), policy_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(policy_revision)='integer' AND policy_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9223372036854775807),
 approval_id TEXT, command_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(command_hash)=64),
 before_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(before_json)), after_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(after_json)),
 committed_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

notion_captures.schema: CREATE TABLE notion_captures(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,state_json TEXT NOT NULL)

p2_form_submissions.schema: CREATE TABLE p2_form_submissions(record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,collection_revision TEXT NOT NULL,submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL)

p2_page_display.schema: CREATE TABLE p2_page_display(page_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES pages(id),full_width INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(full_width IN(0,1)),presentation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(presentation IN(0,1)))

page_external_context_policy.schema: CREATE TABLE page_external_context_policy(page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id),provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider='gmail'),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version=1),policy_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(policy_json)),PRIMARY KEY(page_id,provider))

page_links.schema: CREATE TABLE page_links(source_page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id),source_block_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES blocks(id),target_page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id),PRIMARY KEY(source_block_id,target_page_id))

page_metadata.schema: CREATE TABLE page_metadata(page_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES pages(id),archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(archived IN(0,1)),icon TEXT,cover_file_id TEXT REFERENCES files(id),favorite INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,last_opened_at TEXT, archived_at TEXT)

page_review_events.schema: CREATE TABLE page_review_events(sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id),actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,reviewed_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT,identity_version INTEGER NOT NULL,content_digest TEXT NOT NULL)

page_snapshots.schema: CREATE TABLE page_snapshots(snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,page_id TEXT NOT NULL,revision TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(snapshot_json)),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(page_id,revision))

pages.schema:
CREATE TABLE pages (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id),
 parent_page_id TEXT, title TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(revision NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(revision,1,1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND (length(revision)<19 OR (length(revision)=19 AND revision<='9223372036854775807'))),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT,
 provenance_json TEXT CHECK(provenance_json IS NULL OR json_valid(provenance_json)),
 UNIQUE(workspace_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id,parent_page_id) REFERENCES pages(workspace_id,id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 CHECK(parent_page_id IS NULL OR parent_page_id<>id)
)

personal_review_activation.schema: CREATE TABLE personal_review_activation(block_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL)

personal_review_schedule.schema: CREATE TABLE personal_review_schedule(block_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL,next_at TEXT NOT NULL)

project_pages.schema:
CREATE TABLE project_pages (
 project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_scopes(project_id), page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id),
 relationship TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relationship IN ('member','pin','exclude')), PRIMARY KEY(project_id,page_id,relationship)
)

project_scopes.schema:
CREATE TABLE project_scopes (
 project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES containers(id), inherit_ancestor_preferences INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(inherit_ancestor_preferences IN (0,1)),
 inherit_workspace_preferences INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(inherit_workspace_preferences IN (0,1)),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(revision NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(revision,1,1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND (length(revision)<19 OR (length(revision)=19 AND revision<='9223372036854775807')))
)

properties.schema:
CREATE TABLE properties (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, collection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections(id), name TEXT NOT NULL,
 type TEXT NOT NULL, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(schema_version>=1), config_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(config_json)),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(revision NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(revision,1,1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND (length(revision)<19 OR (length(revision)=19 AND revision<='9223372036854775807'))),

)

property_options.schema:
CREATE TABLE property_options (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, property_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES properties(id), label TEXT NOT NULL,
 status_group TEXT CHECK(status_group IN ('not_started','in_progress','done')),

)

property_values.schema:
CREATE TABLE property_values (
 record_id TEXT NOT NULL, collection_id TEXT NOT NULL, property_id TEXT NOT NULL, property_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(property_type<>'title'),
 schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(schema_version>=1), value_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(value_json)),
 status_option_id TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN property_type='status' THEN json_extract(value_json,'$') END) STORED,
 PRIMARY KEY(record_id,property_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(collection_id,record_id) REFERENCES records(collection_id,id),
 FOREIGN KEY(collection_id,property_id,property_type) REFERENCES properties(collection_id,id,type),
 FOREIGN KEY(property_id,status_option_id) REFERENCES property_options(property_id,id),
 CHECK(property_type<>'status' OR (json_type(value_json)='text' AND status_option_id IS NOT NULL))
)

provider_audit.schema: CREATE TABLE provider_audit(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,connection_id TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,detail TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

provider_connections.schema: CREATE TABLE provider_connections(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,body_json TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL)

provider_proposals.schema: CREATE TABLE provider_proposals(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,connection_id TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,body_json TEXT NOT NULL,result_json TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

record_dependencies.schema: CREATE TABLE record_dependencies(record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,depends_on_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),PRIMARY KEY(record_id,depends_on_record_id))

record_layouts.schema: CREATE TABLE record_layouts(owner_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(owner_kind IN('collection','record')),owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version=1),layout_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(layout_json)),PRIMARY KEY(owner_kind,owner_id))

record_structure.schema: CREATE TABLE record_structure(record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,parent_record_id TEXT REFERENCES records(id))

records.schema:
CREATE TABLE records (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, collection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections(id), page_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES pages(id),
 sort_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sort_key)=12 AND sort_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(revision NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(revision,1,1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND (length(revision)<19 OR (length(revision)=19 AND revision<='9223372036854775807'))),
 UNIQUE(collection_id,id), UNIQUE(collection_id,sort_key)
)

recovery_point_pages.schema: CREATE TABLE recovery_point_pages(point_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recovery_points(id),page_id TEXT NOT NULL,revision TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(point_id,page_id))

recovery_points.schema: CREATE TABLE recovery_points(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,label TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,event_cursor TEXT NOT NULL)

relation_edges.schema: CREATE TABLE relation_edges(property_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,target_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,PRIMARY KEY(property_id,record_id,target_record_id))

reminder_config_v1.schema: CREATE TABLE reminder_config_v1(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id),revision TEXT NOT NULL,body_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body_json)),generated_through TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

reminder_history_v1.schema: CREATE TABLE reminder_history_v1(reminder_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reminder_config_v1(id),revision TEXT NOT NULL,body_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(reminder_id,revision))

reminder_inbox_v1.schema: CREATE TABLE reminder_inbox_v1(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,reminder_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reminder_config_v1(id),revision TEXT NOT NULL,due_at TEXT NOT NULL,outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled',action TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',action_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,snoozed_until TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

restore_preview_decisions.schema: CREATE TABLE restore_preview_decisions(preview_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES restore_previews(id),decisions_json TEXT NOT NULL,resolved_hash TEXT NOT NULL,requires_decisions INTEGER NOT NULL)

restore_previews.schema: CREATE TABLE restore_previews(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,page_id TEXT NOT NULL,restore_revision TEXT NOT NULL,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,grant_id TEXT NOT NULL,guards_json TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

scheduling_plans.schema: CREATE TABLE scheduling_plans(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version=1),collection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections(id),plan_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(plan_json)),applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)

service_runtime_migrations.schema: CREATE TABLE service_runtime_migrations(version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)

skill_invocations.schema: CREATE TABLE skill_invocations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,identity_hash TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

skill_versions.schema: CREATE TABLE skill_versions(skill_id TEXT NOT NULL,page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id),version INTEGER NOT NULL,definition_json TEXT NOT NULL,archived INTEGER NOT NULL,imported INTEGER NOT NULL,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(skill_id,version))

task_facets.schema:
CREATE TABLE task_facets (
 record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, collection_id TEXT NOT NULL, status_property_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 status_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'status' CHECK(status_type='status'), due_property_id TEXT,
 due_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'date' CHECK(due_type='date'),
 FOREIGN KEY(collection_id,record_id) REFERENCES records(collection_id,id),
 FOREIGN KEY(collection_id,status_property_id,status_type) REFERENCES properties(collection_id,id,type),
 FOREIGN KEY(collection_id,due_property_id,due_type) REFERENCES properties(collection_id,id,type),
 FOREIGN KEY(record_id,status_property_id) REFERENCES property_values(record_id,property_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

template_previews.schema: CREATE TABLE template_previews(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,scope_grant_id TEXT NOT NULL,policy_revision TEXT NOT NULL,plan_json TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

transcript_segments.schema:
CREATE TABLE transcript_segments (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, meeting_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meetings(id), block_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES blocks(id),
 start_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(start_ms>=0), end_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(end_ms>=start_ms), text TEXT NOT NULL, speaker_label TEXT,
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(revision NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(revision,1,1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND (length(revision)<19 OR (length(revision)=19 AND revision<='9223372036854775807')))
)

views.schema:
CREATE TABLE views (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, collection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections(id), container_id TEXT,
 owning_page_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL,
 schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(schema_version>=1), query_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(query_json)), config_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(config_json)),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(revision NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND substr(revision,1,1) BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND (length(revision)<19 OR (length(revision)=19 AND revision<='9223372036854775807'))),
 FOREIGN KEY(container_id,collection_id) REFERENCES container_collections(container_id,collection_id)
)

excludedTables.ai_proposals: Unapplied review proposals; their canonical effects are protected in destination tables.
excludedTables.ai_runs: Generated run/draft output and citations; intentionally written by PrepareAI/FinishAI, not applied page content.
excludedTables.document_extractions: Derived extraction status; source files and their bytes remain protected.
excludedTables.document_sections: Rebuildable extracted-text projection; source files remain protected.
excludedTables.personal_review_model_runs: Derived personal-review execution/draft receipt; activation, plan blocks, approvals and applied content remain protected.
excludedTables.personal_review_runs: Derived personal-review execution/draft receipt; activation, plan blocks, approvals and applied content remain protected.
excludedTables.search_chunks: Rebuildable text projection of protected canonical sources.
excludedTables.search_dirty: Pending refresh bookkeeping for the derived text index.
excludedTables.search_embeddings: Rebuildable embedding projection; actual model inputs are bound separately.
excludedTables.search_fts: Derived full-text virtual index over search_chunks.
excludedTables.search_fts_config: SQLite FTS5 shadow storage for the derived full-text index.
excludedTables.search_fts_data: SQLite FTS5 shadow storage for the derived full-text index.
excludedTables.search_fts_docsize: SQLite FTS5 shadow storage for the derived full-text index.
excludedTables.search_fts_idx: SQLite FTS5 shadow storage for the derived full-text index.
excludedTables.search_vector_models: Derived vector-index identity registry; new vector tables remain protected by default.
excludedTables.sqlite_sequence: SQLite internal auto-increment allocation bookkeeping; committed event/history rows are protected.
